name: Lim Seong Hai Capital Berhad
overview: 2026年，LSH Capital 在 Property Development & Management 板块推进多项开发项目，包括以 RM197.90 million 收购 Selangor 约 17.4 acres 土地进行开发，以及就 LSH Bund 混合开发项目（GDV RM500.0 million）签订战略合作协议；Construction Business 板块获得 Pahang 道路升级项目（Projek Menaiktaraf Jalan FR03）的临时分包合约。此外，公司完成向 LSH Morib GCC 和 LSH Morib Development 的股份认购。
overview_en: In 2026, LSH Capital advanced several development projects under its Property Development & Management segment, including the acquisition of approximately 17.4 acres of land in Selangor for RM197.90 million for development and the signing of strategic collaboration agreements for the LSH Bund mixed development project (GDV RM500.0 million); the Construction Business segment secured a provisional sub-contract award for the Pahang road upgrade project (Projek Menaiktaraf Jalan FR03).

segments.name: 物业发展与管理的
segments.note: 今年推进多项物业发展项目，包括收购土地及签订混合开发项目的战略合作协议。
segments.note_en: This year the segment advanced several property development projects, including land acquisition and strategic collaboration agreements for mixed development projects.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Astana Setia Development Sdn Bhd 与 Railway Assets Corporation 签订有条件买卖及开发协议，以 RM197.90 million 收购 Selangor 约 17.4 acres 土地并进行开发。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Astana Setia Development Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and development agreement with Railway Assets Corporation to acquire approximately 17.4 acres of land in Selangor for RM197.90 million and undertake its development.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : COMBINATION OF TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Astana Setia Sdn Bhd 与 Airman Sdn Bhd 签订 BEST 战略合作协议，开发位于 Kuala Lumpur 的 LSH Bund 混合开发项目（52 层，估计 GDV RM500.0 million）。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Astana Setia Sdn Bhd entered into a BEST Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Airman Sdn Bhd for the development of the LSH Bund mixed development project in Kuala Lumpur (52 storeys, estimated GDV RM500.0 million).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : COMBINATION OF TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 LSH Best Builders Sdn Bhd 签订 BEST 战略合作协议，开发位于 Selangor 的 Lot 2072 混合开发项目。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary LSH Best Builders Sdn Bhd entered into a BEST Strategic Collaboration Agreement for the development of the Lot 2072 mixed development project in Selangor.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Besteel Engtech Sdn Bhd 认购 LSH Morib Golf & Country Club Sdn Bhd 和 LSH Morib Development Sdn Bhd 新普通股的股份认购已完成。
actions.text_en: The shares subscription by Besteel Engtech Sdn Bhd of new ordinary shares in LSH Morib Golf & Country Club Sdn Bhd and LSH Morib Development Sdn Bhd was completed.

segments.name: 建筑业务
segments.note: 今年获得 Pahang 道路升级项目的临时分包合约，并签订相关战略合作协议。
segments.note_en: This year the segment secured a provisional sub-contract award for a road upgrade project in Pahang and entered into a related strategic collaboration agreement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 LSH BEST Builders Sdn. Bhd. 就 Pahang 的 Projek Menaiktaraf Jalan FR03 道路升级项目签订 BEST 战略合作协议，并接受临时分包合约。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary LSH BEST Builders Sdn. Bhd. entered into a BEST Strategic Collaboration Agreement and accepted a provisional sub-contract award in respect of the Projek Menaiktaraf Jalan FR03 road upgrade project in Pahang.
